The original Counter-Strike map is one of five Counter-Strike maps that the mappers of [[The Wizard's Manse]] are creating/converting. ===Items=== {{MapItems |quad=1 |ring=1 |pent=1 |hp100=2 |ra=1 |ya=1 |ga=1 |lg=1 |rl=1 |gl=1 |sng=1 |ng= |ssg=2 }} ==Gallery== mirage_center_3.png mirage_GA_4.png mirage_GL_4.png mirage_LG2.png mirage_Pent2.png mirage_ya.png Mirage_radar.png ==Layout== The quakeworld version of Mirage is close to the original size, but with T-spawn and CT-spawn cut down a bit. Even with a rather big mapsize the speed of quakeworld and the flow of the map makes it fast. The items are perfectly placed out for a well balanced map. This version of mirage is set to night time.

==Strategy & Tactics== It will take a lot to get control of the whole map as armors, megas, RL, LG and powerups are spread out nicely. YA is close to Quad and RA is on the other side of the map. Keeping armors and let the quad go hunting for frags should not be far from a good strategy. Also there are not much cells on the map so use it at the right times! ===Download=== You can download the map [https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/mirage.bsp HERE]
